newsitem.title: HONG KONG: BTR buys in China vibration isolator maker.
newsitem.headline: BTR buys in China vibration isolator maker.

text.p: BTR Plc's BTR AntiVibration Systems Inc has bought a 55 percent stake in Wuxi CSI Vibration Isolator Co Ltd of China for US$13.9 million from Regal International Inc, Regal's president Mico Chung said.
China Strategic Holdings Ltd, which owns 49.5 percent of Regal, also has a small stake of below 10 percent in Wuxi CSI but has agreed to hold on to it as a long-term investment, Chung said.

"BTR AntiVibration would like to enter the China market through this acquisition and it asked China Strategic to stay to liaise with the Chinese side," Chung, who also an the executive director of China Strategic, told a news briefing on Thursday.
BTR would bring in new technology to the China vibration isolator joint venture and thus enhance its earning capacity, Chung said. -- HONG KONG NEWSROOM (852) 2843 6369
